snippet.title: THE ONLY EYE: ARCANE LEGACY — Official Trailer #1 | Action Roguelite RPG
snippet.description:
The Only Eye: Arcane Legacy is a 2D pixel art action RPG with roguelite elements, challenging bosses, deep build customization, multiple classes and an evolving endgame.

Build your character, master powerful abilities, discover relics, combine elemental effects and face increasingly dangerous challenges as you uncover the secrets behind the Only Eye.

Wishlist THE ONLY EYE: ARCANE LEGACY on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5238140/The_Only_Eye_Arcane_Legacy/

Coming Fall 2026.

Developed by BitRoot Studios.

#TheOnlyEye #IndieGame #Roguelite
